sections.heading: Mobile app data not syncing
sections.text: The mobile app syncs when it is online and the user is signed in. Entries made offline are kept on the device and sync automatically when a connection returns. Reinstalling the app can delete entries that have not synced.

steps.text: Ask the user to confirm the app version in Settings > About is the current release.
Ask the user to confirm the device is online and that the app shows Signed In.
Ask the user to pull down on the home screen to start a manual sync.

information_needed.prompt: The app version shown in Settings > About.
The device model and operating system version.

stop_conditions.text: Do not advise removing the app while entries are waiting to sync; escalate to L2 if the pending count does not decrease.
